Q9033.reason: Article 31(1) of the Vienna Convention sets out exactly this general rule: good faith, ordinary meaning, context, and object and purpose.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is a raised, firm overgrowth of scar tissue, not a fine hairline scar and not linked to drain removal.
